scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Match the VINs.
scenes.body: The plate on the brake servo should match the chassis rail. Imports must really be 25+ years old.

scenes.title: It rots from the inside.
scenes.body: Fresh underseal or checker plate can hide it. Get underneath with a light.

scenes.title: Footwells, corners, vent flaps.
scenes.body: Repair is real money: a new bulkhead runs about £1,600 in the UK.

scenes.title: Pitted chrome means trouble.
scenes.body: It chews the seals and wears the pins. Wobbly steering points here.

scenes.title: Is it really a NAS?
scenes.body: Real NAS 110s (1993) and 90s (1994–97) have numbered badges and US VINs. Plenty are dressed-up Euro trucks.

scenes.title: Plus a printable checklist.
